prompt:
Matched RecHarness Amazon task: four datasets Movies_and_TV,
Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, CDs_and_Vinyl, macro-average validation
HR@10. Start from RecHarness sasrec_perdataset. Preprocessing seed=0 and training
seed=42, exactly as run2.sh. The host executes your train.py and then independently
evaluates working/predict.py using the pinned RecHarness benchmark (200 validation
users/category, 99 unique negative candidates, evaluation seed=42). Test labels and
test metrics are unavailable during search. Retain all four categories and dataset
routing. DATA_DIR must remain os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; write artifacts beneath
your trial directory, as the baseline does. Training may change model architecture,
loss, optimizer, sampling and hyperparameters, as in RecHarness. Do not alter input
splits, invent metrics, read hidden test files, fetch extra datasets/pretrained weights,
or change the host evaluator. Changes to inference must also update the predictor
writer so working/predict.py loads the trained architecture. Keep execution single-GPU;
the host provides four concurrent trial slots and 64 CPU cores. No shell actions,
filesystem inspection, or training tools are needed in the LLM call: return code.
All training, diagnostics, debugging and failed trials consume the method's shared
43,200 GPU-second search budget. LLM time and final held-out inference are recorded
separately, matching run2.sh's separate final-evaluation step.
The original RecHarness tools layer sets SASREC_EPOCHS=200 (overriding the template's
standalone default of 300); this same environment default applies here.

METHOD: self_evolverec

Diagnostic task adapter: diagnosis_tools.py must retain class DiagnosisProbe(view, device)
and method run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions.
view.model is the actual trained nn.Module. view.item_emb, log2feats(sequence),
predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, review_data implement the
initial SASRec compatibility contract. Adapt probes when changing the architecture.
train_loader yields (None, sequence, positive, negative), tensors of shape B x L.
Only public interaction histories, item titles, descriptions and timestamps are available.
Review ratings/text, item ratings/categories/prices/stores are NOT available in this
shared RecHarness task. Never invent them. Simulator diversity/conformity traits are
explicitly unobserved. Twenty real training users (five/category) receive full-catalog
unseen-item recommendations, as the native simulator requires. Selection uses the
common macro validation HR@10, replacing the native HR@5/NDCG@5 combined score.

    Here are the definitions of what these metrics mean:
    {
  "Movies_and_TV:history_edits": "Frozen-model sensitivity, not recommendation accuracy. Draws are averaged within user, then users equally. Five supplied users/category are exploratory, not representative. Aggregate four complete category reports externally with equal weights; never treat absent reports as zero.",
  "Movies_and_TV:matched_history_edit_contrasts": "Within-user differences between edit summaries, averaged equally across paired users. Require all preregistered draws in both conditions. Bootstrap paired user differences with 2000 seeded replicates. Negative overlap contrasts mean less overlap under the first edit; signs of other fields follow their definitions. These are sensitivity comparisons, not recommendation improvements. Users absent from every successful condition remain visible in panel metadata and failures.",
  "Movies_and_TV:top10_overlap": "Intersection of original and edited top min(10,C), divided by min(10,C); higher is greater stability, not necessarily greater accuracy.",
  "Movies_and_TV:top10_mean_absolute_rank_displacement": "Mean absolute change in zero-based full-catalog rank over the original top min(10,C); stable descending score sorting breaks ties by ascending item ID.",
  "Movies_and_TV:strict_pair_flip_rate": "Fraction of a fixed deterministic sample of at most 4096 distinct unordered candidate pairs whose strict ordering reverses. Exclude pairs tied in either condition; report ties and denominator. Undefined denominators return null.",
  "Movies_and_TV:raw_mean_absolute_score_change": "Mean absolute paired logit change. Scale-dependent; cannot be compared as accuracy or interpreted as invariant sensitivity.",
  "Movies_and_TV:feature_l2_change": "L2 change in the encoder's final feature at position L-1, separately from score/rank effects; representation-scale-dependent.",
  "Movies_and_TV:training_margins": "Mean, lower empirical p10, P(negative>positive), and P(margin<0.5) under the stated independent training-only diagnostic distribution. Not directly comparable to live-loader margins; raw values depend on logit scale. Missing cases are null, not zero.",
  "Movies_and_TV:embedding_geometry": "At most 2048 nonpadding rows sampled with a local seed-42 generator. Mean cosine measures directional alignment only. Centered singular-value entropy gives effective rank, normalized by min(n-1,d); leading mass uses singular values, not squared energy. Neither proves collapse or user diversity.",
  "Movies_and_TV:edit_policy": "Recent deletion removes the final item; old deletion retains it. Preanchor/early comparisons both retain the final item and use min(k,n-2) deletions. Random deletion has the same primary k and reports its final-item policy. Compaction changes positions as well as content; these are not retrained ablations.",
  "Movies_and_TV:exploratory_user_bootstrap_95_interval": "2000 seeded within-category user bootstrap replicates after averaging draws within user. Undefined with fewer than two users. Full-catalog stability differs from pinned sampled-candidate HR@10; adaptive-selection intervals remain exploratory.",
